newsitem.title: USA: Suit alleges United Auto misrepresentations.
newsitem.headline: Suit alleges United Auto misrepresentations.

text.p: Plaintiff's attorneys said Thursday a class action lawsuit was filed Wednesday in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York charging misrepresentations in the prospectus for United Auto Group Inc's initial public stock offering.

The attornys' firms, Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP and Schiffrin & Craig, Ltd, said the civil action was field on behalf all persons who purchased United Auto common issued in connection with the IPO on October 23, 1996, through February 26, 1997.

Their statement said the complaint charges United Auto, certain of its officers and directors, and the underwriters of its IPO with violations of the Securities Act of 1933, alleging the prospectus included material misrepresentations and omissions concerning the then-present status of the company's dealership acquisition strategy and financial condition. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
